game.name: Hitman : HD Trilogy (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De)(Disc 1)
game.desc:
Hitman HD Trilogy bundles three games in the Hitman series that have been remastered for this trilogy release along with the promotional Sniper Challenge game that came as a pre-order for Hitman: Absolution. Except for Hitman: Blood Money on the Xbox 360, none of the included titles were previously available on the platforms. The package includes:
Hitman 2: Silent Assassinnn Hitman: Contractsnn Hitman: Blood Moneynn Hitman: Sniper Challenge
